plan.title: Forward auction auto-title for two locations

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the event type to Auction without entering a title.
Apply the first available auction template so the product sheet is available; the catalog cannot constrain it to a forward template.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Forward Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name

steps.note: Verify the untitled event receives an automatic title after the first location is selected.
Add the second row for the same product.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Forward Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - 2 locations

steps.note: Verify the automatic title updates to reflect the two locations.
Remove the second row while the title remains automatically managed.

steps.note: Verify the automatic title updates again after a row is removed.
